dbt_dev.dim_drg.description: DRG-to-service-line lookup, a thin passthrough of seed_drg_service_line.

drg_key.description: Surrogate key (hash of drg_code). Join key to fct_medicare_drg.

drg_code.description: Medicare Severity Diagnosis Related Group (MS-DRG) code.

drg_description.description: MS-DRG description text (long names may be truncated in the seed).

service_line.description: Clinical service line this DRG is grouped into (e.g. Cardiology, Orthopedics, Obstetrics).

dbt_dev.dim_geography.description: One row per CBSA (metro area) with Census ACS demographics.

cbsa_code.description: Core-Based Statistical Area code. Join key from dim_hospital.cbsa_code.

metro_name.description: Metro area name from the Census ACS.

median_household_income.description: Median household income in US dollars for the metro area (ACS).

total_population.description: Total population of the metro area (ACS).

median_age.description: Median age in years of the metro area population (ACS).

insurance_universe.description: Population for whom health insurance status was determined (ACS denominator).

uninsured_count.description: Number of people without health insurance in the metro area (ACS).

uninsured_rate.description: uninsured_count / insurance_universe, a fraction between 0 and 1.

dbt_dev.dim_hospital.description: One row per hospital (CCN), enriched with CBSA, cost-report ownership, and RUCA rurality.

hospital_key.description: Surrogate key (hash of ccn). Join key to the fact tables and marts.

ccn.description: CMS Certification Number, the 6-character federal hospital identifier.

hospital_name.description: Hospital name as listed in CMS Care Compare (Hospital General Information).

city.description: City where the hospital is located.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory code (e.g. GA, TX, PR).

county.description: County where the hospital is located.

hospital_ownership.description: Human-readable ownership category from CMS Care Compare, e.g. 'Voluntary non-profit - Private', 'Proprietary', 'Government - State'. Prefer this over ownership_type for readable output.

emergency_services.description: Whether the hospital provides emergency services (flag from Care Compare).

birthing_friendly_designation.description: Whether the hospital has the CMS Birthing-Friendly designation.

hospital_overall_rating.description: CMS overall star rating, 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest). Can be missing when the hospital is not rated.

cbsa_code.description: Core-Based Statistical Area (metro area) code derived from the hospital's physical ZIP via the HUD crosswalk. Join key to dim_geography. NULL for ~138 rural hospitals outside any CBSA.

ownership_type.description: Numeric ownership code from the CMS cost report. Use hospital_ownership for readable labels.

rural_urban.description: Rural/urban classification from the CMS cost report.

provider_type.description: Provider type from the CMS cost report.

medicare_payment_cbsa.description: CBSA used for Medicare payment (wage index) per the cost report. Can differ from cbsa_code when the hospital reclassified to another area's wage index. An attribute, not a join key.

ruca_code.description: USDA Rural-Urban Commuting Area code for the hospital's ZIP (from the Medicare inpatient file).

ruca_description.description: Text description of ruca_code (metropolitan core, small town, rural, etc.).

is_cbsa_reclassified.description: True when medicare_payment_cbsa differs from cbsa_code (wage-index reclassification). NULL, not false, when either value is missing.

dbt_dev.fct_hospital_finance.description: One row per hospital (stg_cost_report is already deduped to the latest fiscal year per CCN). Dollar amounts are in US dollars.

fiscal_year_begin_date.description: Start date of the hospital's cost report fiscal year.

fiscal_year_end_date.description: End date of the hospital's cost report fiscal year.

number_of_beds.description: Number of beds reported on the cost report. NULL for 8 hospitals.

total_bed_days_available.description: Total bed days available during the fiscal year.

total_costs.description: Total hospital costs for the fiscal year in dollars.

total_charges.description: Total gross (pre-discount) charges in dollars. Far larger than total_costs; not revenue.

inpatient_total_charges.description: Gross charges attributable to inpatient services in dollars.

outpatient_total_charges.description: Gross charges attributable to outpatient services in dollars.

cost_to_charge_ratio.description: ~1% NULL in this table (down from ~24% in raw cost_report -- nearly all of that sparsity belongs to non-acute-care facility types already excluded by dim_hospital's filter). Legitimate missing data, not a pipeline defect, so not_null is severity warn.

charity_care_cost.description: Cost of charity care provided, in dollars.

uncompensated_care_cost.description: Cost of uncompensated care in dollars, as reported on the cost report.

total_unreimbursed_uncompensated_care.description: Total unreimbursed and uncompensated care in dollars, as reported on the cost report.

net_income.description: Hospital net income in dollars; negative means a loss.

net_income_from_service_to_patients.description: Net income from patient services only, excluding other income, in dollars.

net_patient_revenue.description: Patient revenue after contractual allowances, in dollars. Use this as the revenue figure for margins and percent-of-revenue ratios. Non-positive for 5 hospitals because of upstream reporting errors.

is_ccr_outlier.description: True where cost_to_charge_ratio is outside [0, 1]. See assert_ccr_between_0_and_1.

dbt_dev.fct_medicare_drg.description: Medicare inpatient payments, grain is hospital x DRG, from a single CMS public-use period (DY24). There is no year column, so year-over-year questions cannot be answered from this table.

total_discharges.description: Number of Medicare inpatient discharges for this hospital and DRG. Additive; sum it, do not average it.

avg_submitted_covered_charge.description: Average dollar amount the hospital billed per discharge for covered services (per-discharge average).

avg_total_payment_amount.description: Average total payment per discharge in dollars, including Medicare, beneficiary coinsurance/deductible and other payers.

avg_medicare_payment_amount.description: Average payment by Medicare alone per discharge in dollars. Never above avg_total_payment_amount.

dbt_dev.mart_burden_vs_community.description: Grain is one row per hospital (mart_finance_scorecard + dim_geography community stats, not pre-aggregated). uninsured_rate is NULL for the 138 hospitals with no CBSA (rural, outside any metro area) -- not_null is scoped to hospitals that have one.

metro_name.description: Metro area name; NULL for non-metro hospitals.

net_patient_revenue.description: Patient revenue after contractual allowances, in dollars.

charity_pct_of_revenue.description: Charity care cost as a fraction of net patient revenue.

uncompensated_pct_of_revenue.description: Uncompensated care cost as a fraction of net patient revenue.

median_household_income.description: Median household income of the hospital's metro area, in dollars.

uninsured_rate.description: Share of the metro area's population without insurance, a fraction between 0 and 1.

dbt_dev.mart_finance_scorecard.description: Grain is one row per hospital. charity_pct_of_revenue / uncompensated_pct_of_revenue use net_patient_revenue as the denominator and are NULL (not a garbage negative/divide-by-zero value) for the 5 hospitals with non-positive net_patient_revenue (see model SQL comment).

cbsa_code.description: Metro area (CBSA) code; NULL for non-metro hospitals.

metro_name.description: Metro area name; NULL for non-metro hospitals.

number_of_beds.description: Number of beds from the cost report; NULL for 8 hospitals.

net_patient_revenue.description: Patient revenue after contractual allowances, in dollars.

charity_care_cost.description: Cost of charity care in dollars.

uncompensated_care_cost.description: Cost of uncompensated care in dollars.

net_income.description: Net income in dollars; negative means a loss.

charity_pct_of_revenue.description: charity_care_cost / net_patient_revenue, a fraction (0.05 = 5%). NULL when revenue is non-positive.

uncompensated_pct_of_revenue.description: uncompensated_care_cost / net_patient_revenue, a fraction (0.05 = 5%). NULL when revenue is non-positive.

dbt_dev.mart_reimbursement_gap.description: Grain is hospital x DRG. derived_cost = charges x cost_to_charge_ratio; margin = medicare_payment - derived_cost. Hospitals with no usable CCR are excluded (see model SQL comment) so margin/derived_cost should never be NULL here.

cbsa_code.description: Metro area (CBSA) code of the hospital; NULL for non-metro hospitals.

metro_name.description: Metro area name; NULL for non-metro hospitals.

service_line.description: Clinical service line of the DRG (e.g. Cardiology, Orthopedics).

total_discharges.description: Medicare discharges for this hospital and DRG. Additive.

charges.description: Average submitted covered charge per discharge in dollars.

medicare_payment.description: Average Medicare payment per discharge in dollars.

cost_to_charge_ratio.description: Hospital-wide cost-to-charge ratio from the cost report (same for every DRG of a hospital).

derived_cost.description: Estimated cost per discharge in dollars = charges x cost_to_charge_ratio. An estimate, not a reported cost.

margin.description: Estimated margin per discharge in dollars = medicare_payment - derived_cost. Negative means Medicare pays less than estimated cost.

dbt_dev.mart_service_line_margin.description: Grain is service_line x metro (metro_name NULL = non-metro hospitals). Ranking columns are intentionally NULL for groups under the 30-discharge volume threshold (see model SQL comment) -- not_null on those two is scoped to meets_volume_threshold = true rows only.

service_line_margin_key.description: Surrogate key of service_line and metro_name.

metro_name.description: Metro area name; NULL means the non-metro group.

avg_margin.description: Unweighted mean of per-discharge margin across hospital x DRG rows, in dollars. Not volume-weighted.

total_medicare_payment.description: Sum of average Medicare payment across the group's hospital x DRG rows, in dollars.

total_derived_cost.description: Sum of derived_cost across the group's hospital x DRG rows, in dollars.

total_discharge_volume.description: Total Medicare discharges in the group.

meets_volume_threshold.description: True when total_discharge_volume >= 30. Groups below it are excluded from ranking.

global_rank.description: Rank of avg_margin across all qualifying groups, 1 = worst (lowest) margin. NULL when below the volume threshold.

metro_rank.description: Rank of avg_margin within the same metro, 1 = worst (lowest) margin. NULL when below the volume threshold.
